issue: दूत मिले आनन्द मनाते: who the दूत are (Bālājī's messengers, or 'those who meet the messengers').
alternatives: Those who meet his messengers rejoice.

issue: आन फिराया मुगदर घोटा: आन as 'coming' (आकर) or 'his authority/oath' (आन फिराना, to proclaim one's sway).
our reading: Coming, he whirled the club and cudgel.
alternatives: He proclaimed his sway and the club and cudgel were whirled.

issue: रामानुज प्राण दिवाकर … माँ अंजनी चाकर: दिवाकर ('sun') for the one who restored Lakṣmaṇa's life; चाकर may be 'servant (of Rāma)' rather than of Añjanī.
our reading: The sun of Lakṣmaṇa's life; son of Śiva and servant of Mother Añjanī.
alternatives: Son of Śiva and of Mother Añjanī, (Rāma's) servant.

issue: जब बाबा की भक्त ऊचारे: जब ('when') leaves the line open (read as introducing the devotees' cry in chaupāī 27); it may be a slip for जय ('devotees cry victory to Bābā', as in chaupāī 20).
our reading: When the devotees call out to Bābā: (chaupāī 27).
alternatives: जय बाबा की भक्त ऊचारे: devotees cry victory to Bābā.

issue: सुमर बाल रूप कल्याणा: कल्याणा as 'bringing good' or the poet's name Kalyāṇa (do1, chaupāī 40, do3).
our reading: Remembering the child-form that brings good, he fulfils one's wishes.
alternatives: Kalyāṇa remembers the child-form, who fulfils wishes and tasks.

issue: जो सत पाठ करे … बागीसा: सत 'a hundred (times)', as in the Hanumān Chālīsā's सत बार, or 'truly'; बागीसा (Vāgīśa, lord of speech) may be Bṛhaspati/Brahmā or Hanumān himself.
our reading: Whoever recites it a hundred times, the Lord of Speech is pleased with him.
alternatives: Recites it truly; Hanumān (as master of speech) is pleased.
